provenance.styleAnchor: Accepted M1 B-direction (docs/ART_DIRECTION_M1.md) and figure/lin_b_draft palette: outline #424e46, muted teal #477c7b, cream #eadcbb, terracotta #b96a55, warm woods, flat fills with opacity overlays, no filters.
provenance.supportAgreement: Declared support counter y=400 equals the painted data-support-top=400 on counter_top_surface (top quad back edge y368, front edge y430, resting line y400); closes the M0/M2 declared-vs-painted defect class at the source.
provenance.materials: M4 layer passes (docs/ART_MATERIALS_M4.md), declared through the M3 set-layer seam: material_pigment = region palettes (each region its own light/shade pigment family, warm key glaze left, cool ambient fill right); material_detail = scale-keyed contours and detail recovery (near silhouettes weighted, far art thinned, speculars restored, on surfaces nothing hides - never over a prop the base art puts behind the counter); lighting_shade + lighting_key = one declared light model (source: the left window; key #f7e8c3, ambient fill #5f6a72, radial falloff around x330 y290 art units; shadows cast to the right/back), composited above the actor plane so set and actors share the source. Round 5 withdrew two things the fourth perceptual review saw as geometry: the shared feathered prop matte (m4_prop_hold_off) that held the washes off the ten drawn props, and the whole material_paper pass (per-ground fibre tiles, shade hatch, dry-brush bands) plus material_detail's seven fibre joint plates. Round 6 replaced the matte with layer order instead of a cut-out: the props layer declared above every wash holds the drawn props out of all four passes by compositing, not by a hole, so no hold-off geometry exists to present a boundary of its own - the wash now ends on the prop's own ink edge, which the art draws. It carries the props the M3 composition draws in front of the whole set - the display case, the bowl stack and the steamer with its steam, moved verbatim from the base layers. A prop the art draws behind something stays in its base layer, because a layer above the washes is above the counter and the actor plane too: the hanging sign, jar shelf, small jar and cloth runner are behind the actors, and the drinks cooler, the crates, the A-board and the wall chalkboard are behind the counter. Each remaining pass covers the whole frame as one gradient with no cut-outs and no prop exclusions; nothing tiles, so nothing repeats at a pitch. All marks are static vector art; no filters, no raster, no per-actor projected shadow. Blending is the M4 declared-layer extension (blend/opacity).
